answer: A farm of 373 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in juniper, queued in echo, and pearl publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. A farm of 1844 identities would post 1806 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
